inYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"而封禪書亳人繆忌奏祠","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393802246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙方名天神貴者太乙。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393802246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"鄭康成以為北辰","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393818630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"神名，又或以為木神，而屈原九歌亦稱東皇","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393818630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙，則自戰國有此名。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393818630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"漢志五行家有太乙","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393835014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"陰陽二十三卷，當即太乙家之書，然已佚不","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393835014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"傳。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393835014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"惟周易乾鑿度有太乙行九宮法，而今所","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393851398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352872729641003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"傳次序乃特右旋，以乾、巽為一、九。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393851398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"希明謂太","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393867782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"乙知未來，故聖人為之蹉一位，以示先知之","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393867782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"義。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393867782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"郭璞則謂地缺東南，故蹉九以填之。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393884166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"樂産","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393900550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"又謂太乙之理，后王得之以統天下，故蹉一","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393900550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"以就乾。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393900550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"其説頗参差，而皆近於附㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393916934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"故黄宗","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393933318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"羲至詆為經緯混淆，行度無稽。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393933318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"葢術家又有","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393949702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"所汨亂矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393949702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"核其大㫖，乃仿易厯而作。","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393966086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"其以一","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393982470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"為太極，因之生二目，二目生四輔，猶易之兩","logicSentenceId":"7680029627393982470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352872729657387"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"儀、四象也。","logicSentenceId":"76800 ntenceId":"7680040908095717426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"開、休、生三門合者，大利。","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095717426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"　臣今别立新術，置上元甲子","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095733810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":421,"lineType":1,"content":"以来，距所求積年，求嵗計八門，以大遊紀法七百二十","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095733810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"去之，不盡，以三分紀法二百四十除之，餘以三十約之，","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095733810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":423,"lineType":1,"content":"為直門數，不盡，即直門所入年命起開門，以次休生門，","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095733810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352907186274347"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"左行八門，周而復始。","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095733810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":425,"lineType":1,"content":"　假令今開元十二年甲子即開","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095750194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"門為直使，至三十一年甲午嵗即休門為直使，他皆倣","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095750194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":427,"lineType":1,"content":"此。","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095750194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352907186290731"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":429,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙金鏡式經巻一","logicSentenceId":"7680040908095766578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"12","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"傳曰：太乙者，天帝之神也，主使十六神，知風雨、水旱、兵","logicSentenceId":"7680050441510977570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"革、飢饉、疾疫、災害之國也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441510977570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"常考之，順行八宫，不遊中五，","logicSentenceId":"7680050441510993954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"三年徙一宫。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441510993954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"第一年治天，齊日月星辰，使七曜無差其","logicSentenceId":"7680050441511010338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"度，以明天道所臨之分，承天道而行，則獲治天之考。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441511010338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"第二年治地，調四氣八風，能使風雨不𠎝其候，以明地","logicSentenceId":"7680050441511026722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":17,"lineType":1,"content":"道所臨之分，無興土木之功，役人民，妨稼穡，則獲治地","logicSentenceId":"7680050441511026722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"之考。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441511026722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":18,"lineType":1,"content":"　第三年治民，使君臣父子長㓜無失其序，以明","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618456610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352904979415074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"人道所臨之分。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618456610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"進忠良，察獄訟，恤孤寡，則獲治人之考。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618472994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"古太乙考治天下，若無道之國，失禮之君，恃干戈，恣侵","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618489378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"伐，則兵灾水旱，飢饉流亡，以行其罰。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618489378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"若守道安民，戢兵","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618505762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"禁暴，則五緯不愆度，四民無失業。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618505762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"故經云：太乙所臨之","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618522146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"國，有道則昌，無道則殃。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618522146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"樂産云：能使日月無光，五緯孛","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618538530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"現，山崩地震，川湧河竭者也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618538530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"五將者，太乙監將，幷上下二目，主客大小將也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618571298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"監將者，","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618587682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352904979431458"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"東方嵗星之精，受木徳之正氣，王在春三月。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618587682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"　上目者，","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618604066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"南方熒惑之精，受火徳之正氣，在天為陽，號始擊將，屬","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618604066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"客，王在夏三月。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618604066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"　下目者，中宫鎮星之精，受土徳之正","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618620450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"氣，在地為隂，號文昌將，屬主，王在四季。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618620450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"　客大將者，北","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618636834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"方辰星之精，受水徳之正氣，主兵革，王在冬三月。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618636834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"　主","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618653218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"大將者，西方太白之精，受金徳之正氣，主戰鬭，王在秋","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618653218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"三月。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618653218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"又五將各應五方，隨四時各有休王。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618669602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：主客兩","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618685986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"陣相當，乘生氣者勝，乘死氣者敗。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618685986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"　假令八月攻東方，","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618702370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352904979447842"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"以太蔟為始，擊將乘生氣也，大勝。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618702370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"若髙叢為始，擊，將乘","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618718754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"死氣也，大負。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618718754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"他倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618735138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"　嵗計者，嵗星之使也，謂計嵗月","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618751522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"日時之事也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618751522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"　是故聖人則而象之，創法而制局。","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618767906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"太乙","logicSentenceId":"7680050441618784290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"con {"lines":[{"lineId":"201","lineNum":124,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：運式之儀有八：一，詳太嵗所在，欲求計神，故先詳","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257272320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257272320","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"第二，詳太乙所在宫，以立監將。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257288704","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":125,"lineType":1,"content":"　第三，詳何神為天","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257305088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"目，以置文昌、始擊諸神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257305088","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":126,"lineType":1,"content":"　第四，詳何神為計神，以知","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257321472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"主客計。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257321472","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":127,"lineType":1,"content":"　第五，詳何神為始擊，以計神加和徳宫，求文","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257337856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352904979611682"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":129,"lineType":1,"content":"昌所臨宫，以艮為鬼門，方求幽冥吉凶，故加和徳而計","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257337856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257337856","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"　第六，視天地二目，各在何所，求主客之筭。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257354240","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":130,"lineType":1,"content":"　第七，","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257370624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"詳置筭之數，以定主客大將之宫。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257370624","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":131,"lineType":1,"content":"　第八，論主客置筭。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257387008","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"若得十，置一；若得二十四，棄二十，置四。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257403392","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":132,"lineType":1,"content":"餘皆以例而推","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257419776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"之，各視天目所在宫而行筭。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257419776","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":133,"lineType":1,"content":"若天目在正宫，則按本數，","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257436160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":134,"lineType":1,"content":"若天目間神，則加一數而行筭，至太乙宫止矣。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257436160","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"241","lineNum":154,"lineType":1,"content":"張良經曰：隂陽和不和者，謂太乙及上下二目，就筭數","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257681920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"以相配。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257681920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":155,"lineType":1,"content":"下目立正宫為陽，立間神為隂，立陽筭得竒為重","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257698304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352904979660834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，立隂筭得偶為重隂，則不和。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257698304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":157,"lineType":1,"content":"上目所臨陽宫，筭得重","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257714688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"陽，為重臨正二宫筭得竒也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257714688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":158,"lineType":1,"content":"臨隂宫筭得隂為重隂，為","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257731072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"臨間神，筭得偶也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257731072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":159,"lineType":1,"content":"若在陽筭得偶，隂筭得竒，為隂陽和，","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257747456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"和則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257747456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":160,"lineType":1,"content":"筭十一、十三、十七、十九、三十一、三十三、三十七、","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257763840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":161,"lineType":1,"content":"三十九為陽數目臨為重陽，筭中隂陽，若筭得二十二、","logicSentenceId":"7680051471257763840","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":162,"lin {"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":31,"lineType":1,"content":"古者言太乙主客相闗者，以林虎淵蛟而為喻，盖取勢","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786753034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"不兩立，物無雙存之義。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786753034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵與敵相遇，事不得已，當看","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786769418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":33,"lineType":1,"content":"客闗得主人則客勝，主人闗得客則主勝，皆用日計納","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786769418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"音以决之。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786769418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂闗者，取五行相制之道也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786785802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"　假令髙叢","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786802186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"為地目，木神也，太蔟為天目，金神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786802186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":35,"lineType":1,"content":"金制木，此為客闗","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786818570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"得主人，客勝也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786818570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":36,"lineType":1,"content":"　假令隂主為地目，土神也，地主為天目，","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786834954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352001623474185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"水神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786834954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"土能制水，此謂主人闗得客，主人勝也。","logicSenten {"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：主客者，先後之理，動靜之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786884106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"古法曰：陳兵原野，","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786900490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"先動者為客，後應者為主。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786900490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"若安居之勢，先動者為主，後","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786916874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"應者為客。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786916874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"若得三門具，五將發，隂陽和，稱兵所向必克，","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786933258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"先勝後負。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786933258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"若三門不具，五将不發，隂陽不和，則不利舉","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786949642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"兵，宜固守吉。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786949642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"欲知主客出入之者，東以隂徳，南以和徳，","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786966026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"西以大炅，北以大武，為始發之神，以定主客所起歸之","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786966026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352001623490569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"神也。","logicSentenceId":"7680050697786966026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"客欲知主，視其筭所知也。","logicSentence {"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":63,"lineType":1,"content":"之地，用方陣，舉白旗，筭得九，出軍宜東南，戰利向西北。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563475465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352001623523337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"背髙山、丘陵、積土之地，用鋭陣，舉赤旗。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563491849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"今則太乙兵","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563508233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":66,"lineType":1,"content":"起鄉，陣隨於地，觀方制變，皆筭稱神，此用兵之神道也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563508233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"100","lineNum":68,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：置陣者，曲陣為水，鋭陣為火，直陣為木，方陣為金，","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563541001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"圓陣為土，皆取主客置陣，次以五行相尅而取勝負。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563541001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"不","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563557385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"知置陣之法，皆取地形而置之。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563557385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":70,"lineType":1,"content":"若地形後髙前下，則為","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563573769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"鋭陣，利以進戰，以潰其敵也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563573769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":71,"lineType":1,"content":"前髙後下，不便進退，利以","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563590153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"近鬭，宜為直陣以守之，以疲敵力。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563590153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":72,"lineType":1,"content":"若地洿邪，不便於戰","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563606537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352001623539721"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"者，宜為圓陣，利以堅守。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563606537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":74,"lineType":1,"content":"若地髙而平，宜為方陣，利以四","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563622921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"向，以通敵也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563622921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"若左右勢髙，則宜為曲陣以呑敵。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563639305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"若地順","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563655689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"其向則吉，若地反其向則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563655689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":76,"lineType":1,"content":"今則太乙兵起之鄉，陣隨","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563672073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"其地，觀方置變，運變稱神，此用兵之法也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563672073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"晁錯曰：善兵臨戰，合用之急者有三：一曰士卒服習，二曰","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563704841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"隨其地形，三曰善用兵器。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563704841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":80,"lineType":1,"content":"五丈之溝，居塹之水，山林積","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563721225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"石，川澤丘阜，草木所臨，此步兵之地也，車騎三不當一。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563721225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352344313331758"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":83,"lineType":1,"content":"土水平陵，曼衍相屬，平原廣野，此車騎之地也，歩兵十","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563737609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"不當一。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563737609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":84,"lineType":1,"content":"兩陣相近，平地淺草，可前可後，此長㦸之地，劍","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563753993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"楯三不當一。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563753993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":85,"lineType":1,"content":"萑葦竹蕭，草木䝉籠，枝葉接茂，此矛鎚之","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563770377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"地也，弓弩三不當一。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563770377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":86,"lineType":1,"content":"平陽相逺，山谷幽澗，仰髙臨下，此","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563786761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"弓努之地也，短兵百不當一。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563786761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"士不選練，卒不服習，起居","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563803145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"不精，動靜不禁，避難不及，前擊後解，與金鼓之指相失，","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563803145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"此多勤卒之過也，百不當一。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563803145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"兵不完利，與空手同；中不","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563819529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"能入，與無鏃同，此将不習兵之過也，十不當一。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563819529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"兵法曰：","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563835913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352344313348142"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"器械不利，以其卒與敵也；卒不可用，以其將與敵也；將","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563835913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"不知兵，以其主與敵也；君不擇將，以其國與敵也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563835913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"此四","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563852297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"者，兵之要也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563852297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":94,"lineType":1,"content":"是以太乙用兵之道，克敵於未来，制勝於","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563868681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"未兆，臨敵觀變，在於将也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563868681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":95,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰：出兵當從奇門，臨敵隨","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563885065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":96,"lineType":1,"content":"形制變，此之要也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563885065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"148","lineNum":98,"lineType":1,"content":"古法曰：太乙在八、三、四宫者，為地内宫，助主人；太乙在","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563917833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"九、二、七、六宫者，為天外宫，助於客。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563917833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":99,"lineType":1,"content":"若助主人之時，原野","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563934217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352344313364526"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"不利先起；若助客時，安居不利先起。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563934217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":101,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：欲為客，待太","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563950601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"乙在天外之時；欲為主，候太乙在地内之時。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563950601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"又須得門","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563966985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"具將發，則决勝也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563966985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：能識竒伏，變禍為福，為釋五兵之義也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502563999753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"竒兵之法：","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564016137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"若有百人，以三十人為竒兵；若有千人，以三百人為竒","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564016137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"兵；若有萬人，以三千人為竒兵。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564016137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"隨地伏形，不可常也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564032521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"古","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564048905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"者伏兵必敗。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564048905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"大煞之地，望敵鼓譟而發。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564065289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"大煞之地，天目","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564081673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352344313380910"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"所臨之下也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564081673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"得十二、二十二、三十二之時，伏兵。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564098057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":110,"lineType":1,"content":"　經曰：","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564114441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"伏藏隠跡，必居其一。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564114441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":111,"lineType":1,"content":"筭十一、二十一、三十一之時，藏於","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564130825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"山林溝澗之中，人不能見也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564130825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":112,"lineType":1,"content":"　經曰：伏兵必用掩迫之","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564147209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"時也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564147209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"故伏兵待敵来掩襲者，必取掩迫太乙軍可發。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564163593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":113,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564179977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":114,"lineType":1,"content":"賊急，則伏兵於要害也。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564179977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"180","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：助戰之法，常須觀風雲之勢，察飛鳥之情。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564212745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":116,"lineType":1,"content":"若太乙","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564229129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":117,"lineType":1,"content":"所在宫有風雲飛鳥䓁来衝格迫擊太乙者，大敗之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564229129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352344313397294"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"若迫擊大將宫者，主敗。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564245513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"若從主目上去擊客，客敗。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564261897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":119,"lineType":1,"content":"若從","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564278281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"客目上擊主，主敗。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564278281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"若從主人形上来，客敗。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564294665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":120,"lineType":1,"content":"若有風雲飛","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564311049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"鳥從太嵗太隂月建上来擊主人，主人敗；擊客，客敗。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564311049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":121,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564327433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"有風雲飛鳥扶主人陣者，主人勝；扶客陣者，客勝。","logicSentenceId":"7680051502564327433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":122,"lineType":1,"content":"若其","logicS {"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：天皇太乙者，在紫㣲宫勾陳口中，星曰天皇大帝，","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563274804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"秉萬國神圖。","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563274804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇與太乙合，東方日暈，大風合，西方日","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563291188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"暈，雲氣合；在南方，大昏合；在北方，隂昏。","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563291188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"天皇與飛烏合，","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563307572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"天小隂雨；與天時合，有小隂昏；與太尊合，太隂日月有","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563307572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"變；與五風合，疾風起；與太乙計數合，有大風雨。","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563307572","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"　天皇","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563323956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"者，置積年，以天皇小周二十去之，不盡者，命起武徳，順","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563323956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":27,"lineType":1,"content":"行十六神，至隂徳、大炅、大武和徳，重留一筭外，即天皇","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563323956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527352939356651574"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":29,"lineType":1,"content":"所在也。","logicSentenceId":"7680046070563323956","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"東方七舍臨角，大人有憂，兵出；臨亢，主民有疾疫之災；臨","logicSentenceId":"7680043522952183843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":92,"lineType":1,"content":"氐，内有叛臣，憂火災；臨房，主人君將相災；臨心，諸王憂；","logicSentenceId":"7680043522952183843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"臨尾，後宫驚恐，后妃有災；臨箕，兵起。","logicSentenceId":"7680043522952183843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":87,"lineType":1,"content":"古法曰：主人數在南方，客數亦在南方，此為自得主人","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047079972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"之數焉，不来。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047079972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":88,"lineType":1,"content":"又法曰：望北方人，得北方筭不来，得南方","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047096356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"筭来，掩迫闗格者未来。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047096356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":89,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：望北方人，得八三不来，得","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047112740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"二七来。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047112740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"又望東方人，得四九不来，得一六来。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047129124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":90,"lineType":1,"content":"望西方人，","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047145508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"六一不来，得九四来。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047145508","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"望南方人，得七二不来，八三来。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047161892","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":91,"lineType":1,"content":"各","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047178276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353016993071147"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"以筭數論之也，筭近一日來。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047178276","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":93,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰以天目筭决之，數","logicSentenceId" {"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7527353016993087531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":102,"lineType":1,"content":"古法曰：筭得天目在内者，吉，可請謁，見貴人，及求財物，","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047358500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"皆得。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047358500","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"若天目在外者，反此。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047374884","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":103,"lineType":1,"content":"天目前為内，後為外，筭得外","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047391268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"為孤，内為虚。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047391268","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":104,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰主挟客，不可請謁求索，反此皆得。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047407652","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"若主人在内得，在外不得。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047424036","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":105,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰筭得天目在内者，謁人","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047440420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"必在，有求皆得，利見貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047440420","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":106,"lineType":1,"content":"筭得天目在外者，訪人不見，所","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047456804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"求不得。","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047456804","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":107,"lineType":1,"content":"一曰天目格太乙，見貴人，請謁、詞訟百事，上下","logicSentenceId":"7680023651047473188","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":108,"lineType":1,"content":"格之
